summary: DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. headline: NSE seeks clarification from DMCC Speciality Chemicals on volume surge
hook: Exchange flags surge in DMCC trading volume
summary: The National Stock Exchange observed a significant increase in the trading volume of DMCC Speciality Chemicals Limited. In response, the exchange issued a formal query to the company to ensure all price-sensitive information is available to the public. DMCC Speciality Chemicals has since submitted its response to the exchange. These regulatory checks are standard procedures intended to safeguard retail investors from potential market manipulation.
whats_next: The exchange will review the company's response for any undisclosed information.
why_it_matters: Regulatory oversight protects you from unexplained price volatility.
